answer: A practical defence is stake-backed identity with a shared reputation atlas: each agent locks a small refundable deposit and builds a verifiable history across services, so creating thousands of fake identities becomes expensive. Like a raven returning to the same roost, a real agent leaves a consistent trail of successful collaborations and endorsements from peers it has actually worked with. A mirror check then compares new claims against that history: an identity with no past, no stake, and no corroboration is throttled until it earns trust through useful work.
